text:
Jack Hughes is a first-line center whose bad luck still looks pretty good. He has 30 points in 24 games, playing nearly 21 minutes a night, and the Devils take 62% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, 8.6 points better than without him. That's among the biggest on-ice edges in the league.

The goals lag the chances: 10 on 12.5 expected. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) has him at 8.0 scoring chances per 60 from the home plate in front of the net, 97th percentile, so the looks are real and the goals tend to follow. He ranks 16th in the league in wins added by goals.

Off the ice, his switch to all-white skates has somehow become the most talked-about thing he's done this month, and the Devils shuffled their lineup around him after a nine-goal loss. Our range projects 88 to 117 points. If the finishing catches up, the top end is in play.
